# GadgetJudge

> GadgetJudge is an independent developer's portfolio of thoughtfully crafted Android apps. The apps are designed to be easy to use and focused on specific everyday tasks.

The website introduces the apps and links to their official Google Play listings. Consult those listings for current availability, features, and purchase information.

## Website

- [GadgetJudge](https://gadgetjudge.com/): The official app portfolio.

## Everyday apps

- [Simplest Shopping List](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gadgetjudge.simplestshoppinglist): A grocery list app with quantities, notes, frequently purchased items, list sharing, and backup and restore. No account is required. List sharing sends a copy of the items; it is not live shared-list synchronization.
- [Simplest Reminder](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gadgetjudge.simplestreminder): An Android reminder app with one-time and recurring schedules, snoozing, reminder search, and backup and restore.

## Optional

- [Pulse Pilot](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.gadgetjudge.pulsepilot): GadgetJudge's arcade game.
